purpose: judge whether the implemented system still follows the intended architecture and quality attributes, and catch drift early
entry_criteria: Approved architecture and decision records exist
Implemented code or a build is available
Reviewer did not write the code under review
procedure: Compare the implemented structure (modules, dependencies, data flows) with the documented architecture and note each divergence.
Check the boundaries rules automatically where possible, such as forbidden dependencies between layers.
Check the quality attributes with evidence: latency measurements, failure behavior, security design, operational readiness.
Classify each divergence as accepted evolution (update the record), defect (fix) or risk (owner and date).
Report findings with severity and the architectural principle affected.
Update the architecture records for accepted changes and track the rest.
acceptance_criteria: Each divergence has a classification and an owner
Quality attributes are checked with evidence
Accepted changes are reflected in the records
Reviewer is independent of the implementers

validation.command: npx depcruise --config .dependency-cruiser.js src   # example; use the language's equivalent

validation.check: compare the module diagram with the code's actual import graph

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A review finds a reporting module reading the orders database directly, against the rule that only the orders service does. It is classified as a risk with an owner and a date, and a dependency rule is added to CI.
